display.purpose: Verdict sentence on the dashboard; the status page sets it larger at clamp(2.5rem, 7vw, 5.5rem).

display-catalog.purpose: The catalog number heading a monitor's page, red when down.

title.purpose: Monitor name under its catalog number, uppercase.

body-sm.purpose: Row secondary lines, form help, error messages.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase labels beside values and on section rules; never a kicker above a heading.

mono.purpose: Catalog numbers in lists, URLs, timestamps, chart labels. 11px is the floor.

mono-value.purpose: Readings in tables and spec lists.

motion.name: ease-out-quick
motion.purpose: Border and background changes on controls, fields, checkboxes, rows.

motion.name: ease-expo-out
motion.purpose: Primary control's red end bar widening on hover; checkbox fill scale-in (120ms).

motion.name: reduced-motion

components.name: Primary Control
components.description: The one main action per view: outlined square control with a red end bar that widens on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-control-primary"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 4v16M4 12h16"/></svg>Add monitor</button>
components.css: .ds-control-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 44px 0 16px; border: 1px solid #ececea; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #ececea; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; } .ds-control-primary::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: -1px; right: -1px; bottom: -1px; width: 28px; background: #f04a2e; transition: width 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-control-primary:hover::after { width: 34px; } .ds-control-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ececea; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Control
components.description: Outlined square control for ordinary actions (Cancel, Edit, Pause).
components.css: .ds-control { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #474744; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #ececea; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-control:hover { border-color: #ececea; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ececea; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-control:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Danger Control
components.description: Destructive action: red label, border turns red on hover.
components.css: .ds-control-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #474744; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #f04a2e; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-control-danger:hover { border-color: #f04a2e; } .ds-control-danger:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ececea; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Square 1px field on the ground with a red caret; technical inputs are set in mono.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; border: 1px solid #474744; border-radius: 0; background: #0c0c0c; padding: 10px 12px; font-family: "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; color: #ececea; caret-color: #f04a2e; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #7f7f79; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: #7f7f79; } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: #ececea; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Tracked-caps rail items; the active one inverts to white with a red end bar.
components.html: MonitorsAlertsStatus page
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; width: 216px; background: #0c0c0c; } .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; color: #a8a8a4; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #141413; color: #ececea; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ececea; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-active, .ds-nav-active:hover { background: #ececea; color: #0c0c0c; padding-right: 40px; } .ds-nav-bar { position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; right: 0; width: 6px; background: #f04a2e; }

components.name: State Tag
components.description: Solid state block plus the state word; the word takes its state colour except for up.
components.html: Up Down Pending
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-right: 24px; color: #ececea; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-block { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Signal Readout
components.description: Last 24 checks as countable blocks: white passed, red failed, outlined empty slot.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; } .ds-chk { width: 7px; height: 12px; background: #ececea; } .ds-fail { background: #f04a2e; } .ds-slot { width: 7px; height: 12px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid #474744; }

components.name: State Strip
components.description: All five code colours, the current state lit and the rest at 18%, so the code decodes itself.
components.css: .ds-strip { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-strip > span { display: block; width: 28px; height: 10px; }

narrative.overview:
Pulse is a catalog of signals printed on a Factory Records sleeve. Every monitor is a numbered entry (PLS 001, PLS 002) and its response times are drawn as white hairlines on matte black stock. The system is flat, ruled and square: 1px lines separate things, outlined controls invite action, and nothing is rounded, lifted or tinted. Surfaces are not boxed into cards; the page is a printed sheet divided by rules.

Colour is a code, not decoration. White means up, red means down, yellow means pending, grey means paused, blue means selection and "now". Colour appears as small solid blocks, as a hairline in a chart, as a catalog number set in red, and as the red end bar on the active control. Everything else is ink on black. This is an Operate-mode instrument: dense where it reports, quiet where it waits, and readable at a glance. The public status page is the same sleeve tuned for non-technical readers, with a larger verdict and one row of days per service.

The type does the identity work. Archivo at its expanded width (wdth 125) sets catalog numbers and verdict sentences; Archivo at normal width carries reading text; Martian Mono carries every measurement, timestamp, URL and code; wide tracked capitals label things that sit beside values. The rejected category default is the rounded zinc card dashboard with KPI tiles, green pills and sparklines.
keyCharacteristics: Matte near-black ground, white hairline ink, zero radius everywhere.
A five-colour state code (white, red, yellow, grey, blue), each colour owning exactly one meaning.
Catalog numbering (PLS 000) as the identity device for every monitor.
Expanded display type for numbers and verdicts; monospace for every measurement.
Hand-built SVG instruments (stacked ridgeline, 24-hour dial, check blocks, day blocks) with HTML labels.
Flat: depth comes from rules and occlusion, never from shadow.

rules.name: The Colour Is A Code Rule
rules.body: Each signal colour has one meaning and only that meaning. Red is down, yellow is pending, grey is paused, blue is selection or now. A colour never decorates, and no meaning borrows another's colour.

rules.name: The White Means Healthy Rule
rules.body: Passed checks, up states and healthy days are white, not green. Uptime percentages on an UP monitor are never coloured red, however low they read; a red number means the monitor is down.

rules.name: The Self-Decoding Code Rule
rules.body: Wherever colour carries state, a label or legend travels with it (state tags pair a block with a word, the state strip shows all five colours with the current one lit, day blocks carry a legend). Colour is never the only signal.

rules.name: The Measured Things Are Mono Rule
rules.body: Every number that was measured or counted (response time, uptime, timestamp, status code, catalog number, URL) is Martian Mono with tabular figures. Prose and names are Archivo.

rules.name: The Eleven Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: No text renders below 11px. Chart labels are HTML positioned beside or over the SVG, never SVG text that scales with the viewBox.

rules.name: The Caps Sit Beside Rule
rules.body: Tracked capitals label a value or open a ruled section; they never stack above a heading as a kicker.

rules.name: The Printed Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. Separate with a rule, emphasise with a heavier rule, respond to hover with the raised wash. No shadow, blur, gradient or glow.

dos: Do keep every corner square (0) and every border 1px.
Do give each state colour exactly one meaning: Sleeve Red down, Pending Yellow pending, Paused Grey paused, Signal Blue selection and now.
Do draw passed checks, up states and healthy days in white.
Do pair every colour signal with a word or legend.
Do set every measurement, timestamp, URL and catalog number in Martian Mono with tabular figures.
Do number monitors as catalog entries (PLS 001) and use the number as their identity in lists, charts and headings.
Do mark the primary action with the red end bar, and only one per view.
Do label charts with HTML at 11px or larger, positioned beside the SVG.
Do break chart lines where there is no data and collapse long empty stretches into a labelled double slash.
Do state the verdict as a sentence in expanded display type.
donts: Don't round anything, add shadows, gradients or glows.
Don't use green for healthy, or colour an UP monitor's uptime number red.
Don't use yellow for warnings that are not the pending state, or grey for anything but paused.
Don't box content into cards or KPI tiles; divide with rules.
Don't set text below 11px or use scaled SVG text for labels.
Don't put tracked capitals above a heading as a kicker.
Don't use the six-column catalog table below 1280px.
Don't draw a flat line across a period with no checks.
